101 Steak and Potato Variations Pt. 1: Loaded Steak and Potato Soup 🥔🥣 Comfort food season is in full swing! Gotta add this one to the menu • Ingredients: 3lbs golden potatoes, chopped 16oz steak, any cut you prefer 32 oz (4 cups) low-sodium beef stock (plus more to reach desired soup consistency) 1 medium yellow onion, diced Salt, pepper, garlic (I used Kinder's The Blend) 1lb bacon, cut into small pieces 1 cup shredded Cheddar cheese, divided 4 Tbsp butter 1/4 cup all-purpose flour 12oz evaporated milk Sour cream for topping (optional) 2 Tbsp chives • Instructions -Cook the bacon in a skillet until crisp. Drain and set aside. Reserve a little bacon for topping. -Add the potatoes, beef stock, salt, pepper, garlic to your 5.5-qt slow cooker. -Cook on LOW for 6–7 hours or HIGH for 3–4 hours, until the potatoes are very tender. -About 30 minutes before serving, puree potatoes with an immersion blender. Melt the butter in a saucepan. Whisk in the flour and cook for 1–2 minutes. -Slowly whisk in the evaporated milk until smooth and slightly thickened. -Stir the cream mixture into the slow cooker and add 3/4 of the cooked bacon, 1/2 cup of the cheddar, and the sour cream. Stir gently. -Cook another 20–30 minutes on LOW. During that time, cook the steak and cut it into small pieces. -Serve topped with the remaining cheddar, bacon, chopped steak, and chives.

Recipe👇🏽 Nashville Hot Mozzarella Sticks Just Got Crispier🌶️🔥 These mozzarella sticks just got a serious upgrade. Double-breaded, fried until golden and crispy, then tossed in a Nashville hot oil that brings the heat. Mozzarella Sticks 3 rectangles low-moisture mozzarella, sliced into ½–1 inch sticks Flour, for dusting 2 eggs, beaten 1½ cups breadcrumbs Oil, for frying Nashville Hot Oil ½ cup hot frying oil 2 tbsp cayenne 1 tsp paprika 1 tsp garlic powder 1 tbsp brown sugar Slice the low-moisture mozzarella into ½–1 inch sticks and lightly dust them in flour. Freeze for 1 hour. Dip the frozen mozzarella into the egg, then breadcrumbs, then back into the egg and breadcrumbs again. Heat your oil to 350°F and fry the mozzarella straight from frozen for 2–3 minutes, until golden and crispy. You’ll know they’re ready when they float to the top and look nice and puffy. Don’t overcrowd the pan. While they’re frying, mix the Nashville hot oil ingredients together. As soon as the mozzarella sticks come out, brush or toss them in the hot oil while they’re still steaming. Serve immediately with ranch. I hope it crunches.

Creamy Cajun Chicken Pasta 🔥 One-pot & ready in under 20 minutes… juicy cajun chicken served with the creamiest garlic parmesan sauce 🤤 If there is one piece of cookware you need in your kitchen, it’s gotta be the @Made In Cookware Saucier!  I’ve been using Made In for a long time and the Saucier is my favorite piece to cook with… it can do everything your sauce pan can do, but better!  If you’re looking to upgrade your cookware, I linked my favorite Made In pieces in my bio. For the Chicken:  -2 large chicken breasts, flattened  -Seasoning: 1 tbsp paprika, 2 tsp garlic powder, 2 tsp onion powder, 2 tsp Italian seasoning, 2 tsp salt, 2 tsp black pepper, 1–2 tsp cayenne pepper (optional)  -1 tbsp olive oil For the Pasta & Sauce:  -8 oz (225 g) rigatoni  -3 tbsp butter  -1 large shallot, finely diced  -6–8 garlic cloves, minced  -1 cup heavy cream, room temperature  -Seasoning: 1 tsp chicken bouillon powder, 1 tsp paprika, 1 tsp garlic powder, 1 tsp Italian seasoning, 1 tsp black pepper  -3/4 cup freshly grated Parmesan (please use fresh!)  -1/2 cup pasta water, as needed (aka liquid gold) Instructions: 1. Pat the chicken dry & pound to an even thickness. Coat with 1 tbsp olive oil, then season on both sides. 2. Boil the pasta in salted water until just shy of al dente. Save at least 1/2 cup pasta water before draining (‼️). Set pasta aside. 3. Heat a large pan or pot over medium heat for a few mins. Add 2 tbsp olive oil, increase to medium-high, add the chicken. Sear for 3–4 mins per side until golden, then reduce heat if needed and cook through. Set aside to rest. 4. Reduce heat to medium. In the same pan, melt the butter, scraping up all that fond. Add the shallot & cook for 5 mins, add the garlic, cook for 1 more min. 5. Reduce heat to medium-low, slowly pour in the cream. Add the seasonings & simmer for 2–3 mins. Reduce heat to low, add the parmesan & stir until smooth. 6. Add the pasta & 1/4 cup pasta water, toss over low heat for 1–2 mins until the sauce is silky. Add more pasta water as needed. Slice the chicken, add it on top, and finish with more parm and fresh parsley!  #easydinner #pasta #recipe #cookingathometiktoktv

One-Pan Chicken Shawarma Rice Bowls 🔥 All the shawarma flavor, none of the extra steps… juicy spiced chicken, onion rice pilaf, refreshing salad and a creamy garlic sauce 🤌 For the Chicken: -1.5 lbs (680g) boneless, skinless chicken thighs -Seasoning: 1 tbsp paprika, 1 tbsp cumin, 1 tbsp onion powder, 2 tsp coriander, 1 tsp allspice, 2 tsp turmeric, 2 tsp pepper, 1 tsp salt -3 tbsp olive oil + 8 garlic cloves -½ lemon, juiced -2 tsp bouillon (I used the roasted chicken base from @Better Than Bouillon) For the Rice: -3 tbsp butter + 1 ½ cups yellow onion, diced -1 tbsp turmeric, 2 tsp paprika, 2 tsp garlic powder, 2 tsp pepper -1 ½ cups basmati rice -3 cups hot water  -3 tsp bouillon  For the Fresh Sumac Salad: -½ large red onion, thinly sliced -1 cup cherry tomatoes, quartered -1 cup cucumber, sliced then halved -1 tsp salt, 1 tsp black pepper & 2 tsp sumac -½ lemon, juiced For the Garlic Sauce: -¼ cup mayonnaise + ¼ cup plain Greek yogurt -2 to 3 garlic cloves + 1 tbsp fresh parsley -1 tsp salt + 1 tsp black pepper -½ lemon, juiced + 1 tbsp olive oil 1. Simmer for 20 mins until cooked. 4. Mix the salad ingredients in one bowl and the sauce ingredients in another bowl. Strawberry Pull-Apart Bread 🍓✨ Dough: 3 cups all-purpose flour (360g) 5 tbsp melted butter (71g) 3 tbsp granulated sugar (38g) 1 tsp salt (6g) 2¼ tsp active dry yeast (7g) 1 large egg (50g) ¾ cup warm milk (180g) 1 tsp vanilla extract Simple Glaze: 1 cup powdered sugar (120g) 1–2 tbsp milk (15–30g) 1 tbsp melted butter (14g) Splash of vanilla extract Strawberry Compote Ingredients:  300g strawberries (about 2 cups, chopped) 75–90g granulated sugar (6–7 tbsp) 1 tbsp lemon juice 10–12g cornstarch (1–1½ tbsp) 30g water (2 tbsp) Instructions: In a bowl, mix warm milk, sugar, and yeast and let sit for 8–10 minutes until foamy, then add the egg, melted butter, and vanilla and mix until combined; add in the flour and salt and knead for about 8–10 minutes until smooth, then cover and let rise for 1 hour or until doubled. Meanwhile, make the strawberry compote by cooking strawberries, sugar, and lemon juice over medium heat until soft and juicy (about 5–7 minutes), lightly mash, then stir in the cornstarch mixed with water and cook until thickened, then let cool completely. Roll the dough into a rectangle, spread the strawberry compote evenly over the surface, cut into strips, stack them, and slice into pieces, then place upright into a greased loaf pan, cover and let rise for another 30 minutes before baking at 350°F (175°C) for 35–45 minutes until golden, then mix the glaze ingredients and drizzle over the warm bread. #breadmaking #strawberry #pullapartbread #baking #recipes

Ingredients * 1 tsp yeast * 3 tbsp sugar * 110 ml milk (⅓ cup + 2 tbsp) * 1 egg * 280 g flour (≈ 2¼ cups) * 1 tsp salt * 38 g softened butter (≈ 2 tbsp + 2 tsp) Cinnamon Sugar Coating * 140 g sugar (≈ ⅔ cup) * 1 tsp ground cinnamon Instructions 1. In a bowl, mix the milk, yeast, and sugar. Add the egg, flour, salt, and softened butter all at once, then mix and coil fold the dough several times. Cover and let rest for 20 minutes. 💥bang bang chicken 🍗 Ingredients  1.5 lbs boneless, skinless chicken thighs season to your hearts desire  salt and pepper onion powder  garlic powder  smoked paprika  Sauce 1/2 cup Kewpie mayo @Kewpieusa  3 tbsp sweet chili sauce  Sriracha to taste  1/2 tbsp lime juice  Instructions  1. Pre heat air fryer to 380°F. Clean and trim off excess fat from chicken thighs and pat dry. Place chicken on a baking sheet or mixing bowl, add seasonings to taste. Drizzle with oil and mix to thoroughly combine ensuring all sides are evenly coated. 2. Air fry chicken thighs at 380°F for 12 to 18 minutes, flipping halfway through. ✨ Cheesy Meat-Stuffed Breakfast Biscuits ✨ A delicious, flaky, and cheese-packed comfort food recipe featuring golden-brown biscuits stuffed with savory ground meat and melted cheese. 🍴 Ingredients: - 1 package refrigerated biscuit dough or homemade biscuit dough - 1 lb ground beef or sausage, cooked and seasoned - 1.5 cups shredded cheddar cheese - 2 tbsp melted butter - 1 tsp garlic powder - Fresh parsley, finely chopped for garnish - Salt and freshly cracked black pepper to taste 👩🏽‍🍳 Instructions: 1. Preheat your oven to 350°F (175°C) and line a baking sheet with parchment paper. 2. Cook the ground meat in a skillet with salt, pepper, and garlic powder until fully browned, then drain excess fat. 3. Separate the biscuit dough, flatten each piece slightly, and place a spoonful of cooked meat and a generous amount of shredded cheese in the center. 4. Fold the dough securely around the filling to form stuffed biscuit balls or rounds, pinching the edges to seal. 5. Arrange the stuffed biscuits on the prepared baking sheet. 6. Brush the tops with melted butter and sprinkle a little extra cheese or parsley on top. 7. Bake in the preheated oven for 15 to 18 minutes until the biscuits are golden brown and cooked through. 8. Remove from the oven, let cool slightly, and serve warm. 📝 Notes: These flaky, cheese-stuffed biscuits make the ultimate grab-and-go breakfast, packed with rich flavor in every single bite. #BreakfastBiscuits #StuffedBiscuits #CheeseLovers #ComfortFood #SavoryBaking

Veal Cutlets 🇮🇹 Ingredients 1 lb (500 g) veal cutlets Plain breadcrumbs Parmigiano Reggiano, grated Fresh parsley, chopped Paprika Salt and black pepper Extra virgin olive oil Instructions 1. Pound the veal cutlets thin and cut into smaller pieces. 2. In a bowl, mix the breadcrumbs, Parmigiano Reggiano, parsley, paprika, salt, and pepper. 3. Press the cutlets into the breadcrumb mixture, coating both sides. 4. Heat a generous amount of olive oil in a large pan over medium-high heat. 5. 101 Steak and Potato Variations Pt. 5: Hungarian Mushroom Soup 🥩🥔 • Ingredients: 2 steaks of your choice (I used NY strips) 3 large russet potatoes 4 Tbsp butter 1 large yellow onion, diced 1lb (16oz) mushrooms, sliced 2 cups chicken broth  1 Tbsp soy sauce 1 Tbsp Hungarian Paprika (or regular paprika if you don’t have any) 2 tsp fresh chopped dill (or dill weed) 3 Tbsp AP flour  1 cup milk 1/2 cup Greek yogurt 1/4 cup chopped parsley Juice of half a lemon Salt and pepper to taste Parmesan cheese as garnish Instructions: -Take your potatoes and poke holes in them with a fork or knife then oil and season them. Bake in the oven at 400°F for 1 hour -While those bake, make the soup and steak. Melt butter in a large pot over medium heat then add onions and cook for 5 minutes until slightly caramelized -Add in sliced mushrooms and sauté for another 5 minutes until browned. I hike up the heat a little during this part to give the mushrooms a rich color -Stir in chicken broth, soy sauce, paprika, and dill. Cover and simmer on low for 15 minutes so the soup develops a rich red-brown color -Whisk together milk and flour until smooth. Stir into the soup. Cover and simmer on low for another 15 minutes, stirring occasionally, until thickened -Stir in Greek yogurt, fresh parsley, lemon, salt, and black pepper to taste. Heat gently for 3–5 minutes without boiling. Cover and set aside while you make the steaks -Once the steaks are resting, the potatoes should be done, then plate up starting with that baked potato, seasoning, parm, soup, steak, more soup, topped with parm and parsley

Cheesy Garlic Butter Crab and Shrimp Bombs Ingredients 1 pound crab meat 1 pound shrimp, peeled and deveined 1 cup cream cheese 1/2 cup grated Parmesan cheese 4 tablespoons garlic, minced 1/4 cup fresh parsley, chopped 1 tablespoon lemon juice 1 teaspoon Old Bay seasoning 1 package crescent roll dough 4 tablespoons butter, melted Instructions Preheat the oven to 375°F (190°C). In a large bowl, mix crab meat, shrimp, cream cheese, Parmesan, garlic, parsley, lemon juice, and Old Bay seasoning until well combined. Roll out the crescent roll dough and cut it into squares. Place a spoonful of the crab mixture onto each square and fold the dough over to seal. Brush the tops with melted butter. Place on a baking sheet and bake for 15-20 minutes until golden brown. Allow to cool slightly before serving.     Prep Time: 20 minutes     Cook Time: 20 minutes     Total Time: 40 minutes     Yield: 20 bombs

Recipe for 12 cookies: 130 g browned butter 40 g cubed butter melted in 160 g brown sugar 50 g white sugar 1 egg 1/4 tsp salt 1/2 tsp espresso powder ﻿﻿1 tbs vanilla paste 195 g all purpose flour 1/2 tsp baking soda 1/4 tsp baking powder 1/2 cup dark chocolate chips 1/2 cup semi sweet coholate  Directions: ﻿﻿1. Preheat oven to 350° F 2. ﻿﻿Brown butter in a sauté pan. Should take about 5 minutes. 3. Once it fizzes up and you can see browned bits, kill the flame. 4. ﻿﻿Pour the butter into a bowl and add the other butter (cubed). 5. Stir until it dissolves. ﻿﻿6. Put into the fridge for 20 minutes or so. I aim for a temperature of 60° F 7. ﻿﻿Add the brown sugar and white sugar to the butter. Whisk/stir for 2-3 minutes until well combined 8. ﻿﻿Add the egg and vanilla paste and mix for another minute until well combined. 9. ﻿﻿Add the rest of the dry ingredients in a bowl and mix.  10. Then add to the wet ingredients. 11. ﻿﻿Slowly mix and incorporate. It's important not to overmix here. 12. ﻿﻿Once there's just a little flour still visible, add the chocolate chips. Gently mix until chips are evenly incorporated. 13. ﻿﻿﻿Make 12 balls, about 65 grams each. Try to keep some chocolate chips on top (it just looks prettier). 14. ﻿﻿﻿Chill in the fridge for at least 30 minutes. But they are best if they've been chilled for 24-48 hours. Or you can freeze for later use. ﻿﻿﻿15. Place on a baking sheet with parchment paper and put in the oven. 16. ﻿﻿﻿About 5 minutes in, slam the tray of cookies on the counter or rack once or twice to flatten them out. ﻿﻿﻿17.
